scope: Isolated original PLY-3 project decoding investigation and prototype; not an integrated fix

reconstructionTrace.method: After the full artifact-read workload, explicitly collect the page heap for diagnosis, then trace project-value reconstruction in the decoder worker.
reconstructionTrace.result: After chunk validation, the worker allocated and filled Float64-backed ordinary arrays of 33263505 and 5612016 values. It allocated a third array of 15991146 values but did not report completing its fill before the GUI and page probe timed out. The guarded run failed and cleaned up; this localizes the last logged stage without proving the exact allocation that stalled.

prototype.method: In the disposable decode worker, keep privately owned Float64 mesh-coordinate chunks as trusted typed views through validation and pack them as numeric transport entries. Reconstruct ordinary arrays on the main side. Chunks used in other roles remain ordinary arrays.
prototype.focusedTests: 42 tests passed across six project transport, decoding, encoding and display-preparation files, including ordinary-array output, signed zero, history/indexed aliases and a shared metadata role. The initial new worker-representation assertion failed on the baseline before the prototype.
prototype.normalReplay: Without forced garbage collection, the full artifact-read and GUI-reopen run timed out without a decoder result. Peak job bytes 4302073856; cleanup confirmed.
prototype.diagnosticGcReplay: With an explicit collection after artifact deletion, GUI reopen completed and all source, cutter and extracted-part core geometry digests matched. The guard reported peak job bytes 4299214848, above the 4294967296 limit, so this is not resource acceptance.

limitations: The prototype has not passed the unassisted resource gate, production typecheck or full suite, public-MCP reopen after download, concurrency, corruption and cancellation validation, or review.
Explicit garbage collection is diagnostic only; no production behavior may depend on it.
Source-role discovery and worker-only trusted views need further safety and alias review. No application change or milestone completion is claimed.
